notes.title: So many update!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

These days I worked a lot, after collecting your opinions, to fix several bugs and improve the general experience of the game. I hope you can enjoy the updates that include:
- Life system has been revolutionized
- FPS improvement
- Improved HUD graphics
-Suplify the first missions
- Fixed many bugs
- Improved overall stability

I look forward to receiving your opinions! Enjoy the game!

Thank you all my friend!
